{
  "score": 6,
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh",
      "category": "hot-path overhead",
      "severity": "medium",
      "line": 1866,
      "message": "The `iter > 0` guard is always true (the loop starts at `_start_iter` ≥ 1), so `eb_emit_event \"stage.start\"` fires for every cycle member in every iteration on every run—fresh runs included—adding an unconditional I/O call to the innermost dispatch hot path where none existed before.",
      "quote": "if [[ \"$iter\" -gt 0 ]]; then\n            eb_emit_event \"stage.start\" \"stage=$s\" \\",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh",
      "category": "subprocess per loop member",
      "severity": "low",
      "line": 1444,
      "message": "On the first resumed iteration the CMBR-1 guard forks a `jq` subprocess for each cycle member to read its status from the state file, rather than reading and caching the relevant section once before the member loop.",
      "quote": "_cmbr_status=\"$(jq -r --arg s \"$s\" '.stage_statuses[$s] // \"pending\"' \\\n                \"$state_file\" 2>/dev/null || echo \"pending\")\"",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    }
  ]
}
